{{Quote|Welcome to the Coronet starport. I trust all of your travel needs will be met in an efficient and courteous matter.|Jesseb Convorr|<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" />}}
'''Jesseb Convorr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was high-ranking employee of the [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Starport]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Jesseb Convorr, the starport master, has sent in a report of vandalism in the starport. He'd like someone to find those responsible and stop them from doing it again.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper|Jasper]]|<ref name="SWG:CSV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Starport Vandalism|Corellia}}</ref>}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Jesseb Convorr served as the starport master of the [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Starport]], in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Convorr worked with a spacer to find a missing shipment ordered by the businessman [[Ral Mundi]]. The spacer finally discover that it was in fact stolen by the [[Ragtags]].<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /> A short time later, Jesseb Convorr requested the assistance of the [[Corellian Security Force]] because of the destruction of several terminals in the Starport. CorSec [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]] sent him a spacer to investigate the vandalism. While Convorr immediately suspected the [[Meatlumps]], the spacer discovered that the Ragtags were responsible, and trying to blame the Meatlumps for the vandalism.<ref name="SWG:CSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jesseb Convorr was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Jesseb Convorr was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]", on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He was part of the quest named "Find the Missing Shipment of Starship Components", best known as "Ral Mundi's quest".<ref name="SWG:TTE">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Find the Missing Shipment of Starship Components"</ref> Ral Mundi's quest was revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]", on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 27 is now live!">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=66900&month=022006|text=Publish 27 is now live!}}</ref> as the quest was inserted into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" />
